decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits at the core of the firm's water-infrastructure fittings business, was upgraded to its own page in 2019, and likely meets aspiration levels with little cost to carry, so there is no shortfall prompting search.

The powder-coated public waste bin is distant from the core but uses the existing coating and fabrication capacity and sells to the same municipal customers, so modest slack lets the firm carry it despite uncertain results.

The waste bin with ashtray line shares production and municipal buyers with Product D, so the incremental cost is low, although several models in an unfamiliar street-furniture market may fall short of aspirations and invite pruning.

Outdoor ashtrays are the furthest from the pipeline core and the most exposed to an aspiration shortfall, but as part of a coherent coated urban-furniture diversification built on existing equipment they are likely kept for now rather than dropped.
